css: /* ===== Prism Animation Lab — NEW additions (nfl-*) ===== */ /* ENTRANCES */ @keyframes nfl-peekIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}} @keyframes nfl-zoomBlurIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.4);filter:blur(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);filter:blur(0)}} @keyframes nfl-swingGateIn{from{opacity:0;transform:perspective(600px) rotateY(-100deg)}to{opacity:1;transform:perspective(600px) rotateY(0)}} @keyframes nfl-cornerFoldIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-40px,-40px) scale(.6) rotate(-12deg)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,0) scale(1) rotate(0)}} @keyframes nfl-slotMachineIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-120%);filter:blur(3px)}60%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(10%);filter:blur(0)}80%{transform:translateY(-4%)}100%{transform:translateY(0)}} @keyframes nfl-elasticDropIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-80px)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}65%{transform:translateY(-18px)}80%{transform:translateY(0)}90%{transform:translateY(-6px)}100%{transform:translateY(0)}} @keyframes nfl-flyInArc{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-70px,50px) rotate(-25deg)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0)}} /* EXITS */ @keyframes nfl-vanishUp{0%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-40px) scale(.6)}} @keyframes nfl-slideFlipOut{0%{opacity:1;transform:perspective(500px) rotateY(0) translateX(0)}100%{opacity:0;transform:perspective(500px) rotateY(90deg) translateX(40px)}} @keyframes nfl-tornadoOut{0%{opacity:1;transform:rotate(0) scale(1) translateY(0)}100%{opacity:0;transform:rotate(720deg) scale(0) translateY(20px)}} @keyframes nfl-blindsOut{0%{opacity:1;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}100%{opacity:0;clip-path:inset(50% 0 50% 0)}} @keyframes nfl-glitchOut{0%{opacity:1;transform:translate(0);clip-path:inset(0)}20%{transform:translate(-6px,2px);clip-path:inset(20% 0 40% 0)}40%{transform:translate(6px,-2px);clip-path:inset(50% 0 10% 0)}60%{transform:translate(-4px,0);clip-path:inset(10% 0 60% 0)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(0);clip-path:inset(0)}} /* ATTENTION */ @keyframes nfl-boing{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scaleY(1)}20%{transform:translateY(-20px) scaleY(1.1)}40%{transform:translateY(0) scaleY(.8)}55%{transform:translateY(-8px) scaleY(1.05)}70%{transform:translateY(0) scaleY(.95)}} @keyframes nfl-pingPong{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-22px) scaleX(1)}45%{transform:translateX(20px) scaleX(1)}50%{transform:translateX(22px) scaleX(.85)}} @keyframes nfl-flashPop{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);filter:brightness(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.15);filter:brightness(1.8)}} @keyframes nfl-nod{0%,100%{transform:perspective(400px) rotateX(0)}30%{transform:perspective(400px) rotateX(25deg)}60%{transform:perspective(400px) rotateX(-10deg)}} @keyframes nfl-shakeNo{0%,100%{transform:perspective(400px) rotateY(0)}25%{transform:perspective(400px) rotateY(35deg)}75%{transform:perspective(400px) rotateY(-35deg)}} @keyframes nfl-glowBreath{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(var(--pos-rgb),.3)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 24px 8px rgba(var(--pos-rgb),.7)}} /* LOADERS */ @keyframes nfl-doubleRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(var(--info-rgb),.5),0 0 0 0 rgba(var(--info-rgb),.3)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 16px rgba(var(--info-rgb),0),0 0 0 30px rgba(var(--info-rgb),0)}} @keyframes nfl-barFill{0%{transform:scaleX(.1)}100%{transform:scaleX(1)}} @keyframes nfl-spinnerPulse{0%{transform:rotate(0) scale(1)}50%{transform:rotate(180deg) scale(.7)}100%{transform:rotate(360deg) scale(1)}} @keyframes nfl-dotWave{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}30%{transform:translateY(-14px)}} @keyframes nfl-progressStripe{0%{background-position:0 0}100%{background-position:32px 0}} @keyframes nfl-flipCubeLoad{0%{transform:perspective(220px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)}50%{transform:perspective(220px) rotateX(180deg) rotateY(0)}100%{transform:perspective(220px) rotateX(180deg) rotateY(180deg)}} /* MORPHS */ @keyframes nfl-squircleMorph{0%,100%{border-radius:12px}33%{border-radius:50%}66%{border-radius:30% 70% 70% 30%/30% 30% 70% 70%}} @keyframes nfl-colorMorph{0%{background:var(--crit);border-radius:12px}50%{background:var(--info);border-radius:50%}100%{background:var(--pos);border-radius:12px}} @keyframes nfl-gooeyPulse{0%,100%{border-radius:40%;transform:scale(1)}50%{border-radius:55% 45% 50% 50%;transform:scale(1.1)}} @keyframes nfl-liquidWobble{0%,100%{border-radius:60% 40% 30% 70%/60% 30% 70% 40%}50%{border-radius:30% 60% 70% 40%/50% 60% 30% 60%}} /* EASING SHOWCASES */ @keyframes nfl-backOutY{0%{transform:translateY(-60px);opacity:0}70%{transform:translateY(8px);opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(0)}} @keyframes nfl-anticipateJump{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scaleY(1)}15%{transform:translateY(12px) scaleY(.85)}45%{transform:translateY(-40px) scaleY(1.1)}70%{transform:translateY(0) scaleY(1)}} @keyframes nfl-springRotate{0%{transform:rotate(0)}60%{transform:rotate(370deg)}75%{transform:rotate(355deg)}88%{transform:rotate(363deg)}100%{transform:rotate(360deg)}} @keyframes nfl-overshootScale{0%{transform:scale(.6)}55%{transform:scale(1.15)}75%{transform:scale(.95)}100%{transform:scale(1)}} /* 3D TRANSFORMS */ @keyframes nfl-cubeTumble{0%{transform:perspective(400px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)}100%{transform:perspective(400px) rotateX(360deg) rotateY(360deg)}} @keyframes nfl-swing3D{0%,100%{transform:perspective(500px) rotateX(35deg)}50%{transform:perspective(500px) rotateX(-35deg)}} @keyframes nfl-depthPush{0%,100%{transform:perspective(600px) translateZ(0);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}50%{transform:perspective(600px) translateZ(60px);box-shadow:0 24px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}} @keyframes nfl-hologramSpin{0%{transform:perspective(500px) rotateY(0) skewX(0);opacity:1}50%{transform:perspective(500px) rotateY(180deg) skewX(8deg);opacity:.6}100%{transform:perspective(500px) rotateY(360deg) skewX(0);opacity:1}} /* PATH / OFFSET MOTION */ @keyframes nfl-figureLoop{0%{transform:translate(0,0)}25%{transform:translate(24px,-16px)}50%{transform:translate(0,0)}75%{transform:translate(-24px,-16px)}100%{transform:translate(0,0)}} @keyframes nfl-arcHop{0%{transform:translate(-30px,0)}50%{transform:translate(0,-30px)}100%{transform:translate(30px,0)}} /* GLITCH */ @keyframes nfl-glitchSkew{0%,100%{transform:translate(0) skewX(0)}20%{transform:translate(-4px,0) skewX(6deg)}40%{transform:translate(4px,0) skewX(-6deg)}60%{transform:translate(-2px,0) skewX(3deg)}80%{transform:translate(2px,0) skewX(-2deg)}} @keyframes nfl-rgbSplit{0%,100%{text-shadow:0 0 0 transparent}25%{text-shadow:-3px 0 rgba(255,0,60,.8),3px 0 rgba(0,200,255,.8)}50%{text-shadow:3px 0 rgba(255,0,60,.8),-3px 0 rgba(0,200,255,.8)}75%{text-shadow:-2px 0 rgba(255,0,60,.8),2px 0 rgba(0,200,255,.8)}} /* JELLY / SPRING */ @keyframes nfl-jellyLand{0%{transform:translateY(-30px) scale(1)}50%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}60%{transform:scaleY(.7) scaleX(1.3)}75%{transform:scaleY(1.1) scaleX(.9)}90%{transform:scaleY(.97) scaleX(1.03)}100%{transform:scale(1)}} @keyframes nfl-springSwing{0%{transform:rotate(0)}20%{transform:rotate(12deg)}40%{transform:rotate(-9deg)}60%{transform:rotate(6deg)}80%{transform:rotate(-3deg)}100%{transform:rotate(0)}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[data-fx-id^="lab-"] *{animation-duration:0s!important}}
tiles:
▲
Peek In
nfl-peekIn
Wipes up into view from a clipped baseline while nudging upward — a clean reveal for rows and cards.

◉
Zoom Blur In
nfl-zoomBlurIn
Rushes up from a small, defocused state and snaps sharp — a focus-pull entrance with depth.

⇱
Swing Gate In
nfl-swingGateIn
Hinges open from the left edge on the Y axis like a gate swinging toward you into place.

◤
Corner Fold In
nfl-cornerFoldIn
Drifts in from the upper-left corner shrinking and untwisting — a diagonal tuck-in for tiles.

🎰
Slot Machine In
nfl-slotMachineIn
Drops from above with a motion blur, overshoots the landing, then clicks onto its mark like a reel.

⇊
Elastic Drop In
nfl-elasticDropIn
Falls in and rebounds twice with shrinking hops — a rubbery multi-bounce landing.

↗
Fly In Arc
nfl-flyInArc
Sweeps up from the lower-left along a tilted path, unwinding rotation as it arrives.

⇧
Vanish Up
nfl-vanishUp
Lifts and shrinks while fading away — a light dismiss that sends the element upward off stage.

⇲
Slide Flip Out
nfl-slideFlipOut
Turns edge-on around the Y axis while sliding right — folds shut and drifts off in one move.

🌀
Tornado Out
nfl-tornadoOut
Whirls through two full turns while collapsing to nothing — spun away like a funnel.

▤
Blinds Out
nfl-blindsOut
Closes toward the middle from top and bottom via clip-path — window blinds snapping shut.

▓
Glitch Out
nfl-glitchOut
Tears into jittering clipped bands then blinks out — a corrupted-signal exit for tech UIs.

🟣
Boing
nfl-boing
Springs up and lands with a squash then a smaller rebound — bouncy character weight.

⇆
Ping Pong
nfl-pingPong
Slides left to right and back, squashing at the far edge on impact — a lively lateral shuttle.

✷
Flash Pop
nfl-flashPop
Brightens and swells at the midpoint — a quick spotlight flare to draw the eye to a badge.

✓
Nod
nfl-nod
Tips forward and back on the X axis like a yes gesture — a friendly 3D acknowledgment.

✕
Shake No
nfl-shakeNo
Turns side to side around the Y axis like a no gesture — a 3D rejection cue for invalid input.

◈
Glow Breath
nfl-glowBreath
A soft green halo swells and fades on a slow breath — a calm success or online indicator.

◯
Double Ring
nfl-doubleRing
Two concentric shadow rings pulse outward and dissolve — a layered radar ping loader.

▮
Bar Fill
nfl-barFill
Stretches from a sliver to full width along its left edge — an indeterminate progress sweep.

✦
Spinner Pulse
nfl-spinnerPulse
Rotates a full turn while dipping in size at the halfway point — a breathing spinner loader.

●
Dot Wave
nfl-dotWave
Bobs up and back on a short cycle — chain several with delays for a typing-dots loader.

≡
Progress Stripe
nfl-progressStripe
Diagonal barber-pole stripes scroll endlessly across the fill — the classic busy-bar texture.

⬛
Flip Cube Load
nfl-flipCubeLoad
Tumbles on X then Y in sequence like a die rolling over its edges — a playful busy state.

⬢
Squircle Morph
nfl-squircleMorph
Cycles from rounded square to circle to an asymmetric squircle — a shape-language demo.

◐
Color Morph
nfl-colorMorph
Blends fill colour while rounding to a circle and back — hue and shape shift together.

◕
Gooey Pulse
nfl-gooeyPulse
Swells slightly while its corners soften unevenly — a squishy blob that gently throbs.

💧
Liquid Wobble
nfl-liquidWobble
Drifts between two lopsided droplet outlines — a slow liquid-metal idle distinct from a blob.

⤓
Back Out Y
nfl-backOutY
Drops in past its target then eases back up — a back-ease showcase with a clean overshoot.

⤴
Anticipate Jump
nfl-anticipateJump
Crouches down to load up, then launches high before settling — classic anticipation easing.

↻
Spring Rotate
nfl-springRotate
Spins a full turn, overshoots, and jitters onto the mark — a springy settle for dials and knobs.

◎
Overshoot Scale
nfl-overshootScale
Pops past full size then eases back down — a compact back-ease pop for confirmations.

⬢
Cube Tumble
nfl-cubeTumble
Rotates continuously on both X and Y axes for a die-tumbling-through-space feel.

▦
Swing 3D
nfl-swing3D
Rocks forward and back on the X axis in perspective — a hanging-sign sway with real depth.

⧉
Depth Push
nfl-depthPush
Pushes toward the viewer on the Z axis as its shadow deepens — a genuine lift out of the plane.

✧
Hologram Spin
nfl-hologramSpin
Rotates on Y with a slight skew and opacity dip when edge-on — a flickering holographic panel.

∞
Figure Loop
nfl-figureLoop
Traces a looping figure-eight-style path across four points — hands-free wandering motion.

◠
Arc Hop
nfl-arcHop
Travels left to right along a raised parabola — a projectile arc for hop-across transitions.

▚
Glitch Skew
nfl-glitchSkew
Jumps between offset skews in hard steps — a datamosh shear jitter for glitch aesthetics.

R
RGB Split
nfl-rgbSplit
Offsets red and cyan ghosts left and right in steps — a chromatic-aberration glitch on glyphs.

🟪
Jelly Land
nfl-jellyLand
Drops, splats into a wide squash, then wobbles tall-and-short to rest — gelatinous impact.

🔔
Spring Swing
nfl-springSwing
Swings hard then settles through decaying rotations around a top pivot — a bell rung once.
